name: Choukyou Shidou Nisshi ~Gakuen Touseiroku~
original_name: 超狂指導日誌 ～学園統制録～
source:
A mysterious journal where anything written inside is guaranteed to come true.

After obtaining the "Super Mad Guidance Journal," the protagonist uses its power to become the principal of Kandori Girls' Academy, one of the country's most prestigious elite schools.

Located in a remote mountainous area, this boarding school is an ultra-elite institution where only selected daughters of the upper class are permitted to enroll. The protagonist, whose social status would normally not even allow him to approach the grounds, has come to this academy to become a ruler who claims the finest women for himself.

Using his privileges as the school principal, the protagonist gains the right to teach students as a teacher, and after writing something in his super-crazy teaching diary, he immediately heads to the class of a female student he has his eye on, "Kizuki Yuina." There, he is greeted by the shameless sight of the female students, topless and exposing their breasts, just as he had written in the diary.

From this day onwards, the protagonist begins a life of chaotic carnal indulgence and lewd domination at the prestigious girls' school, which has become a convenient hunting ground for him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1361154]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
一本神秘的日记，里面写的任何东西都保证会成真。

获得《超狂指导日记》后，主角利用其力量成为了全国最负盛名的精英学校之一——神取女子学园的校长。

这所寄宿学校位于偏远山区，是一所超级精英学府，只允许上流社会的精选女儿入学。原本社会地位不允许他踏入校园的主人公，来到这所学园，成为一名将最好的女人据为己有的统治者。

主角利用校长的特权，获得了作为老师教导学生的权利，在超疯狂的教学日记中写下一些内容后，他立即前往他看中的女学生“木月结奈”的班级。在那里，映入眼帘的是那些无耻的女学生，她们赤裸着上身，袒露着胸部，正如他在日记中所写的那样。

从这一天起，主角在名牌女校开始了混乱的肉欲纵欲和淫荡支配的生活，这里成了他便利的狩猎场。
